principles: Reach is an engagement-solution envelope rather than a universal fixed range.
Weapon technology uses the weakest of principal band, FTL Path rank, and installed conventional engine generation rather than the most favorable label.
Within-band legacy, standard, refined, advanced, and prototype weapon-chain variants materially change performance without escaping the vessel technology ceiling.
A weapon family cannot be operational below its minimum technology rank even when an imported or malformed installation record names that family.
Unguided weapons lose solution quality as light delay, flight time, track uncertainty and target maneuver increase.
Directed energy loses concentrated effect through divergence, dwell limits, tracking error and thermal authority.
Guided missiles update in flight but expend acceleration, delta-v, time and terminal correction while facing active defense.
Countermeasure missiles receive their own interception envelopes and do not automatically destroy incoming threats.
VESSEL-07 never resolves an impact voxel, penetration, module damage or destruction result.
